item.title: Benny Gantz in Ma’ale Adumim: E1 corridor is an important strategic security asset
item.description:
Blue and White chairman Benny Gantz toured Ma’ale Adumim and said the E1 corridor, which he said connects the city to Jerusalem, is “an important strategic security asset and an integral part of Jerusalem’s future infrastructure."
He added that the Jerusalem perimeter should receive a comprehensive national response as part of the capital’s metropolitan area.

item.title: “The games are over:" Ben Gvir confronts residents in Bir Hadaj
item.description: The National Security Minister visited Bir Hadaj and confronted residents during the demolition of illegal structures. “Anyone who breaks the law will encounter the enforcement authorities."
